angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,080,088 km at 38.04 pc = 0.38 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.2854 +/- 0.0170 mas (same row, RUWE 0.98): 38.04 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.553 (1.521 to 1.584) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 1,080,088 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.081 (1.041 to 1.121) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5873 +/- 1.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4650314511916109696: teff_gspphot 5872.779 K (16th-84th percentiles 5871.2285-5874.5493), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 4650314511916109696: teff_gspphot 5872.779 K (16th-84th percentiles 5871.2285-5874.5493), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/bubup.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.090, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 38283 (pscomppars): spectral type F9.5 V, from Gray et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006AJ....132..161G/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 38283 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.18 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 38283 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.41069, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 38283 (pscomppars): age 6.2 Gyr, from Tinney et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJ...732...31T/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 38283 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 3 km/s, from Tinney et al. 2011 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2011ApJ...732...31T/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
